note: Synthetic skills for the test suite, stored as data rather than as real
SKILL.md files. This is deliberate: extract.py walks ~/.claude/skills
recursively, so if these were checked in as actual directories and this
repo were cloned to ~/.claude/skills/skill-index/, they would be indexed
into the user's real library and show up in their docs/SKILLS.md.
Adding 'tests' and 'docs' to SKIP_DIRS would be worse: SKIP_DIRS matches
by directory name at any depth, so a user with a legitimate skill at
tests/support.py writes these into a fresh temporary directory per test.
'root' picks which fake skill root the file lands in, so cross-root
deduplication is testable. 'raw' is the whole file, which is how the
malformed-YAML and no-frontmatter cases are expressible.
